answer: Each agent must solve a per-epoch cipher puzzle binding its identity to a bonded stake, and a rotating juniper-seeded committee certifies the resulting proofs before any cross-shard bridge message is accepted. This bridge admits only identities whose stake-weighted work survives formal verification, so spawning cheap pseudonyms cannot accumulate quorum weight. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
